decisions.reason: The interboard signal connector and pinout do not assign SPI MOSI or otherwise depend on its GPIO number.
Changing SPI MOSI to GPIO47 does not alter the I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cabling constraints.
The interboard power connector requirements do not use SPI MOSI or depend on its GPIO assignment.
The source changes SPI MOSI only and does not change the native USB D+ or D- interface.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the three-board architecture or the roles of the main and sensor boards.
The standalone USB power path and its powered loads remain unchanged by the SPI MOSI reassignment.
The source retains the separate 5V enable assignment at GPIO5 and changes only SPI MOSI to GPIO47.
The source does not change LED voltage, level shifting, standby-current behavior, or LED power control.
The sensor board's role as a connector hub is unaffected by the main-board SPI MOSI GPIO assignment.
The source does not modify the sleep policy, timer wake behavior, or existing touch-wake assignment on GPIO26.
The eight-LED board requirement does not depend on the SPI MOSI GPIO assignment.
The AXP2101 power source, system rails, and battery power path remain unchanged.
